product.olivetti-pcs30-sx40.summary: The slim desktop PCS30 with a 40 MHz 386SX.
product.olivetti-pcs30-sx40.history: Olivetti included the PCS30 SX/40 in the PCS30–PCS40 line of 386 and 486 systems. It documented this model as a slim desktop configuration.
product.olivetti-pcs30-sx40.architecture: Video and storage used expansion cards. With the standard cards installed, 3 of the 5 AT slots remained free in the standard configuration.
product.olivetti-pcs30-sx40.firmware: The board determines which BIOS to look for. The guide documents AMI for WH 386 SX.
product.olivetti-pcs30-sx40.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-pcs30-sx40.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs30-sx40.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, §39, pp. 39-1–39-3.
